name: drawio-skill
description: AI agent skill (SKILL.md) that generates draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions. Supports 6 diagram presets (ERD, UML Class, Sequence, Architecture, ML/DL, Flowchart), exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG, style presets, iterative review loop. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, and any agent that reads SKILL.md files.

install_steps: Then teach skills: sc skills teach drawio-skill:quickstart

baseArgs: drawio-skill v0.1.0 — use sc skills teach drawio-skill:quickstart to load
adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install draw.io CLI first, then clone repo

commands.description: Passthrough — clone the repo and teach the skill

baseArgs: drawio-skill is a SKILL.md file. Clone https://github.com/Agents365-ai/drawio-skill.git then run: sc skills teach drawio-skill:quickstart
